gaps.explanation: Statement p6 (Statement of Revenues, Expenses and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis, Total Proprietary Funds) prints total operating expenses 842,112, which include Depreciation 45,857 and no capital outlay. The detail comes from the budgetary comparison schedules pp17-21 (Light 662,011, Water 48,972, Sewer 52,231, Landfill 35,840, Meter Deposit 1,896 = 800,950), which print no depreciation but include Water Fund Capital outlay 4,695 (p18). Every other cost row ties exactly: Personal services 64,721 = 21,575 + 21,574 + 21,572; Contractual 598,559 = 560,964 + 2,198 + 2,298 + 33,099; Utilities 15,505 = 5,500 + 10,005; Repairs 79,992 = 63,078 + 6,287 + 8,521 + 2,106; Other supplies 37,478 = 16,394 + 8,718 + 9,835 + 635 + 1,896. Gap = depreciation 45,857 - capital outlay 4,695 = 41,162 exactly. Both printed totals are correct on their own basis; no detail line is missing or duplicated.
